questions.prompt: Who was the last Tsar of Russia?
questions.fact: He kept a detailed diary throughout the revolution, and its entries are strikingly preoccupied with the weather.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the galaxy that contains our solar system?
questions.fact: It is on a collision course with Andromeda, though the two are so empty that almost no stars will actually hit.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a piste, a foil and a riposte?
questions.fact: It is one of only five sports to have featured at every modern Olympic Games.

questions.prompt: Which soft drink brand's logo uses a distinctive red and white script?
questions.fact: The script was written by the company bookkeeper in 1886 and has barely changed since.

questions.prompt: Which country was formerly known as Burma?
questions.fact: Both names come from the same root, and which one a government uses has long carried political weight.

questions.prompt: Which term describes a word that imitates a sound?
questions.fact: Different languages disagree about the sounds animals make, which suggests the imitation is less direct than it feels.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of two-factor authentication?
questions.fact: Codes sent by text are the weakest common form, because a phone number can be transferred away from its owner.
